primary_pr.body:
## Summary
- add a short guardian follow-up developer reminder before reused reviews
- cache prior-review state on the guardian session instead of rescanning full history on each request
- update guardian follow-up coverage and snapshot expectations
primary_pr.title: Add guardian follow-up reminder
